messages.subject: Work group tomorrow, 10-12
parts:
Hi Folks,

We will be having our weekly work group tomorrow, and our final work group in 2018! Join us in 360 Shields Library from 10-12 tomorrow (12/11) to work on coding issues, or just to chat with some cool people. Hope to see you then!

Cheers,
Martha
